test_title: PYST 28: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - Quant (Held On 4 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A shopkeeper purchases supplies from a supplier. The supplier sells 750 units of bags to the shopkeeper after gaining the sale price of 125 units of bags. What is the gain percentage of the supplier?
solution:
**Given:**

No. of units bags supplied by supplier = 750 

Gain of units of bags = 125 units

**Formula used:**

Gain = S.P. - C.P. 

Gain % = ( Gain/C.P. ) × 100 

S.P. = Selling Price

C.P. = Cost price 

**Calculation:**

Let the price of 1 unit of bag = Rs.1

S.P. of supplier = 750 units = Rs.750 

Gain of supplier = 125 units = Rs.125

⇒ Gain = C.P. - S.P. 

⇒ 125 = C.P. - 750 

⇒ C.P. = Rs.625.

⇒ Gain% = ( Gain/C.P. ) × 100 

⇒ (125/ 625) × 100

⇒ 20 

**∴ Gain% of supplier is 20%.**
